newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran sentences child rapist and killer to death.
newsitem.headline: Iran sentences child rapist and killer to death.

text.p: A Iranian nicknamed "man with a thousand faces" has been sentenced to death for a long crime spree including kidnapping, raping and killing children, newspapers reported on Sunday.
"Ahmad Taqiabadi, dubbed 'the man with a thousand faces', was sentenced to seven death sentences by the 35th branch of Shiraz general court," the Persian-language Kayhan newspaper reported.

The sentence follows the public execution last Wednesday of an Iranian serial killer dubbed the "Tehran Vampire". The 28-year-old man, who was found guilty of kidnapping, raping and murdering nine girls and women, was hanged from a crane in western Tehran.
Taqiabadi was found guilty of three murders, 12 cases of kidnapping and rape, seven robberies and five cases of forgery.
In addition to the death sentences the court in the southern city of Shiraz on Saturday handed down a sentence of 421 lashes, a 44-year jail term and a fine.
"After confirmation by the Supreme Court he (Taqiabadi) will be executed in public," the Ettelaat newspaper reported.
Taqiabadi had fled from prison in 1985 and travelled across the country, avoiding arrest by assuming numerous identities.
Three accomplices were sentenced to jail terms of between six and 10 years, papers reported.
